root_cause.text: The sequence number for completion wait commands (cmd_sem_val) was incremented atomically outside the IOMMU spinlock, decoupling sequence allocation from command queue ordering and causing out-of-order semaphore values that violate the ordering assumption in wait_on_sem(), leading to completion wait timeouts under concurrent TLB invalidations.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the increment of cmd_sem_val inside the iommu->lock (via `get_cmdsem_val()`) and changes it from an atomic64_t to a plain u64, with the commit message explicitly stating: "cmd_sem_val was incremented outside the IOMMU spinlock, allowing CMD_COMPL_WAIT commands to be queued out of sequence and breaking the ordering assumption in wait_on_sem()."
